title: Quarterly Sprint Chorus: Aligning Hosted API Roadmap and Model Catalog Initiatives
creator: Priya Singh
project: Hosted API + Model Catalog Q2 Runway
description: Coordination epic to synthesize product-level goals for the hosted API and model catalog into a single quarterly execution plan. Objective: reduce cross-team misalignment, define canary/rollback windows, and produce a traceable set of deliverables tied to OKRs for cost-per-token, model-rotation reliability, and onboarding velocity. This ticket captures first-pass backlog, success metrics, and the cross-functional choreography to get engineering, design, and infra into a harmonized sprint cadence.
acceptance_criteria: Quarterly roadmap doc published with initiative owners and milestones
OKR mapping table linking 3 major initiatives to measurable signals (latency SLO, unit cost, model health)
Canary gating plan and rollback thresholds documented and reviewed by SRE
Staging runbook and evaluation prompt set for model swaps uploaded to shared drive
milestones: Week 1: Kickoff + cross-team intake workshop (artifact: Confluence intake)
Week 2: Draft roadmap + OKR alignment with metrics and owners
Week 3: Ops & canary plan review with SRE/Infra/Research
Week 4: Publish roadmap, schedule rollout windows and finalize sprint bundles
